title: SLGO scoreboard payload (scoreboard.snapshot)
description: The CS2 scoreboard's data: both teams' per-side stats, ping, round history and loss bonus. The same payload goes to every client declaring scoreboard; roster, names, alive state, scores and the viewer team's money stay in match.snapshot. elapsed_ms is the match time at the envelope's sent_at. Also enforced by parsers: shots_hit <= shots_fired and utility_damage <= damage in every stats object; rounds strictly increasing; score_to_win <= max_rounds; halftime_after_round < max_rounds; every round <= max_rounds; unique player ids.

mode_name.description: Plugin-authored mode label, e.g. 竞技模式.

score_to_win.description: Wins that take the match (CS2 clinch).

halftime_after_round.description: Last round of the first half; null without halftime.

rounds.description: Finished rounds in order; a round ended without a winner is left out.

loss_bonus.description: Loss-bonus level per team (CS2's four pips); null when the mode has no loss streaks.

winner_role.description: The winner's side in that round.

ping_ms.description: null for bots and when unknown.

stats.description: Match stats while playing one side.

rounds_played.description: Rounds finished on this side (ADR denominator).

shots_fired.description: Firearm shots fired (one per trigger pull, a shotgun blast once).

utility_damage.description: Part of damage dealt with the player's own HE grenades.

enemies_flashed.description: Enemies blinded by the player's own flashbangs.
